title: The Tempered Body Primer
summary: A primer for new Warriors on carrying qi in a tempered body with a sound strike and guard and a breath that closes small hurts.

title: A Handbook of Bone and Sinew
summary: A handbook of blows and guards made from the long bones and the sinew that joins them with a warming breath for strain.

title: The Skin-Hardening Workbook
summary: A workbook of drills that harden the skin with qi until it turns glancing blows and shows the student how to draw out a bruise.

title: Primer of Breath and Blood
summary: A primer on driving qi with the breath and the pulse so the body gains speed and strength and learns to read and calm itself.

title: The Conditioning Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of daily conditioning that turns the stance and the hip into steady blows and throws and ends with a release for strain.

title: A Plain Treatise on Standing Strength
summary: A plain treatise on drawing strength up from the ground through a planted stance and reading the footing of those nearby.

title: The Muscle-Knitting Handbook
summary: A handbook of qi mending for strained muscle and sprung joints that leaves room for one rising kick and a tight guard.

title: The Carrying and Lifting Workbook
summary: A workbook for those who lift and haul that turns heavy work into strength for the arms and a crushing hold.

title: The Rooted Stance Primer
summary: A primer on rooting the stance low and wide so that blows land from the ground and the footing of others can be felt.

title: A Handbook of the Steady Heart
summary: A handbook of keeping the heart and breath steady under strain so the body mends and reads hurt before it answers.
